text: {"features":[{"name":"Academic preparation","description":"Assesses the level of formal technical education the letter presents for a role that prefers graduate study in computer science or a related field.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Presents a relevant bachelor's degree only, with no evidence of formal study beyond the minimum qualification."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Presents a relevant bachelor's degree plus clear advanced study, research training, or postgraduate coursework short of a completed master's degree."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Presents a completed master's degree in computer science or a related technical field."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents doctoral-level study or research training that clearly exceeds a standard master's profile, even if a completed doctorate is not claimed."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents a completed doctoral degree in computer science or a related technical field."}]},{"name":"Relevant software engineering experience","description":"Assesses how much directly relevant professional experience the letter shows in testing, maintaining, and launching software products.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Describes only just-above-minimum relevant experience, with limited breadth of production ownership."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Describes early-career relevant experience that exceeds the minimum only modestly in years or scope."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes solid relevant experience with several years of work and responsibility for multiple production services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes strong relevant experience with repeated ownership across launch, maintenance, and operation of several services."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Describes extensive relevant experience well beyond the minimum, making the candidate look ready to contribute quickly to core systems."}]},{"name":"Go proficiency","description":"Assesses how convincingly the letter establishes Go as a core professional language for backend systems work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions Go only briefly or as one language among many, without showing meaningful depth."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows some professional use of Go, but not enough to make it feel like a major strength."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular professional use of Go for backend work and a comfortable match to the role's requirement."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows Go as a primary working language used across multiple services or significant backend responsibilities."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows Go as a clear core expertise, with sustained ownership of backend systems that maps directly to the role's Go infrastructure work."}]},{"name":"Python proficiency","description":"Assesses how well the letter demonstrates practical Python experience relevant to automation, analysis, and AI agent work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Omits Python or mentions it so vaguely that usable depth is unclear."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions Python as a secondary or occasional tool, with little evidence of production use."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows steady Python use for internal tooling, scripts, prototypes, or services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong Python experience across automation, analysis, or service work used by teammates or production systems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows Python as a deeply trusted production tool, with evidence of building robust services, automation layers, and tooling that others rely on."}]},{"name":"AI production experience","description":"Assesses how much concrete experience the letter shows building and shipping AI or LLM-based functionality.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of hands-on AI or LLM work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"States general interest in AI or limited exposure, but provides little evidence of direct delivery."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows hands-on work with AI features or model-backed functionality in practice."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows meaningful production experience shipping AI or LLM capabilities and dealing with reliability concerns."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows substantial production AI experience with explicit attention to evaluation, trustworthiness, failure modes, or dependable deployment."}]},{"name":"Agentic systems ownership","description":"Assesses experience designing systems that combine autonomous or semi-autonomous agents with controlled supporting infrastructure.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of designing agentic or agent-based systems."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions agents or automation at a high level, but without showing system design responsibility."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows some hands-on work connecting agents to supporting services or workflows."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows clear design ownership of agentic tooling, including boundaries, contracts, or execution controls."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows end-to-end design of agentic systems in which Python agents act within explicit guardrails enforced by deliberate Go backend infrastructure."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability automation","description":"Assesses how directly the letter matches the role's need to automate vulnerability intake, triage, and handling.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of work on vulnerability reporting or triage workflows."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows general security automation interest, but no clear ownership of vulnerability-handling tooling."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows some direct work improving vulnerability intake or triage processes."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows clear ownership of automation that classifies, routes, or prioritizes vulnerability reports and reduces manual work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows end-to-end ownership of vulnerability-handling automation with a concrete workflow transformation, such as turning a manual queue into a largely self-serve or low-touch pipeline."}]},{"name":"Security assessment capability","description":"Assesses how convincingly the letter demonstrates the ability to perform structured security assessments.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows security interest but no concrete evidence of performing security assessments."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions security reviews or assessments vaguely, without method or scope."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows practical experience with at least one assessment practice, such as threat modeling, code review, or design review."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows repeated hands-on security assessment work with clear methods and engineering follow-through."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows strong assessment capability across multiple forms of review, such as threat modeling, attack-surface analysis, validation of fixes, and assessments of systems the applicant did not build."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic rigor","description":"Assesses the strength of evidence that the applicant can use data structures and algorithms to improve real systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no meaningful evidence of algorithmic strength."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Claims algorithmic ability in general terms, but offers little concrete application."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives at least one specific example of using data structures or algorithms to solve a real system problem."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Gives strong, concrete examples showing thoughtful algorithmic redesign of performance-critical or structurally complex systems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes algorithmic skill feel like a core strength, with multiple or especially compelling examples of turning messy or inefficient systems into clean, scalable designs."}]},{"name":"Security fluency","description":"Assesses external or extracurricular evidence that the applicant has developed a genuine security practitioner's mindset.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no credential, competition, or other outside signal of security fluency."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Provides a modest security signal, such as a basic certification or occasional participation in security exercises."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides one solid signal of security fluency, such as regular CTF participation, a recognized certification, or sustained adversarial practice."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Provides a strong signal, such as OSCP-level certification or consistently high CTF performance."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Provides exceptionally strong security fluency signals, such as multiple rigorous credentials or unusually strong offensive practice that clearly deepens the application."}]},{"name":"Role motivation","description":"Assesses how clearly the letter explains why this exact Information Security Engineering role is the applicant's intended next step.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Expresses generic interest in software or security work, with little indication of why this role is a fit."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"States interest in the role, but mostly in broad or interchangeable terms."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives a believable reason for applying that connects to some stated responsibilities or preferred qualifications."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows clear role-specific motivation grounded in the team's mission, responsibilities, or technical stack."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes the fit feel deliberate and compelling by connecting the applicant's trajectory directly to the team's mandate around security automation, vulnerability handling, and developer-facing tooling."}]},{"name":"Foundational leverage orientation","description":"Assesses appreciation for the role's foundational nature and the compounding impact of internal tooling at Google scale.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not show interest in foundational or organization-wide leverage."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Nods to scale or impact in a generic way, without connecting it to internal platforms or shared infrastructure."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows interest in working on systems whose benefits reach many teams or products."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly values foundational engineering and organization-wide leverage as a reason for wanting the role."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Articulates the compounding value of core security infrastructure in a nuanced way, showing strong fit for a team whose work is inherited across a large ecosystem."}]},{"name":"Developer enablement orientation","description":"Assesses whether the letter frames security engineering as making the secure path easier for other developers.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not discuss supporting developers or embedding security into everyday workflows."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions helping teams or improving process only in passing."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows some appreciation for reducing developer friction or making secure behavior easier."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly frames security tooling as a service to developers, emphasizing defaults, proximity to users, or proactive support."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes developer enablement a central theme, showing a strong philosophy of building low-friction systems that let busy engineers do the secure thing by default."}]},{"name":"Maintainer mindset","description":"Assesses whether the letter conveys a reliability-focused habit of building systems that are supportable, durable, and safe to inherit.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Focuses mainly on building features or listing experience, without showing concern for maintainability or failure."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Suggests some operational awareness, but gives limited evidence of a maintainer's perspective."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a clear concern for reliable operation, maintenance, or the realities of inherited systems."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Strongly conveys maintainer habits, such as designing for failure modes, inheritance, or long-term operability."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes maintainability and reliability feel like a defining professional stance, explicitly showing how past experience shaped careful, durable engineering choices."}]},{"name":"Technical initiative","description":"Assesses evidence of self-driven engineering beyond assigned work, such as open-source maintenance or substantial personal projects.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Offers no meaningful evidence of technical initiative outside normal job duties."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions a small side project or occasional outside contribution with limited depth."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows sustained initiative through a modest but real personal build or recurring upstream contributions."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong initiative through serious side projects or meaningful open-source stewardship."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows exceptional self-driven depth, such as maintaining a project with real users or building an ambitious systems project to production-like standards."}]},{"name":"Evidence specificity","description":"Assesses how concretely the letter supports its claims with examples, mechanisms, and outcomes.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Relies mostly on generic claims or adjectives, with little supporting detail."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Includes a few specifics, but leaves most claims largely unsubstantiated."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Supports several claims with concrete examples or named tasks."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Regularly pairs claims with concrete mechanisms, outcomes, or illustrative examples."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Builds a consistently credible case through specific, technically informative examples that show what was built, how it worked, and what changed because of it."}]},{"name":"Writing polish","description":"Assesses the clarity, correctness, and professional readability of the letter itself.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Contains frequent errors or awkward phrasing that materially distract from the content."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Contains noticeable mistakes or roughness that weaken professionalism but do not prevent understanding."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Is readable and generally professional, though some phrasing, structure, or minor errors reduce polish."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Is clear, well-structured, and polished, with only isolated slips if any."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is exceptionally clear, fluent, and polished, with crisp phrasing and essentially no distracting errors."}]}]}
